C1611.title: Shenzhen Longhua Police Dismantle a Private Detective Company
C1611.summary: Shenzhen Longhua police dismantled a private detective company during the "I do practical things for the people" campaign and arrested 10 suspects. The group posted ads online to solicit business, followed targets according to employer orders, took photos, and sent real-time locations, while also being suspected of obtaining citizens personal information through illegal channels, exposing risks of offline stalking and personal information abuse.

references.title: Serving the public: Shenzhen Longhua police dismantle a 'private detective' company, 10 suspects detained
